parameters.jsCode:
const metadata = $json.document_metadata ?? {};
const chunks = $json.chunks ?? {};

const tasks = [
  {
    task_type: 'identity',
    source_section: 'identity_and_preparations',
    text: chunks.identity_and_preparations,
    expected_fields: [
      'scientific_name',
      'herbal_drug_name',
      'plant_part',
      'pharmacopoeia_monographs',
      'preparations',
      'der',
      'extraction_solvents'
    ]
  },

  {
    task_type: 'constituents',
    source_section: 'constituents + overall_conclusion',

text: [
  chunks.constituents,
  '',
  'OVERALL EMA CONCLUSION:',
  chunks.overall_conclusion
].join('\n'),
    expected_fields: [
      'constituent_groups',
      'named_constituents',
      'analytical_markers',
      'active_markers',
      'therapeutic_activity_status'
    ]
  },

  {
    task_type: 'medicinal_use',
    source_section: 'medicinal_use_conclusion',
    text: chunks.medicinal_use_conclusion,
    expected_fields: [
      'indication',
      'regulatory_status',
      'traditional_use_status',
      'well_established_use_status',
      'duration_of_use',
      'medicinal_use_summary'
    ]
  },

  {
    task_type: 'clinical_efficacy',
    source_section: 'clinical_efficacy_conclusion',
    text: chunks.clinical_efficacy_conclusion,
    expected_fields: [
      'clinical_evidence_summary',
      'study_heterogeneity',
      'methodological_limitations',
      'well_established_use_supported',
      'overall_efficacy_conclusion'
    ]
  },

  {
    task_type: 'safety',
    source_section: 'clinical_safety',
    text: [
      'CONTRAINDICATIONS:',
      chunks.contraindications,
      '',
      'PRECAUTIONS:',
      chunks.precautions,
      '',
      'INTERACTIONS:',
      chunks.interactions,
      '',
      'PREGNANCY AND LACTATION:',
      chunks.pregnancy_lactation,
      '',
      'CLINICAL SAFETY CONCLUSION:',
      chunks.clinical_safety_conclusion
    ].join('\n'),
    expected_fields: [
      'contraindications',
      'precautions',
      'interactions',
      'age_restrictions',
      'pregnancy_lactation',
      'adverse_effects',
      'overall_safety_summary'
    ]
  },

  {
    task_type: 'overall_assessment',
    source_section: 'overall_conclusion',
    text: chunks.overall_conclusion,
    expected_fields: [
      'overall_regulatory_conclusion',
      'clinical_evidence_strength',
      'constituent_activity_status',
      'analytical_marker_status',
      'research_gaps'
    ]
  }
];

return tasks.map(task => ({
  json: {
    document_metadata: metadata,
    task_type: task.task_type,
    source_section: task.source_section,
    expected_fields: task.expected_fields,
    text: task.text,
    character_count: task.text?.length ?? 0
  }
}));

parameters.text:
=You are a biomedical evidence extraction system for PhyThera,
a professional medicinal-plant evidence mapping platform.

Your task is to extract structured information from an authoritative
source document.

TASK TYPE:
{{ $json.task_type }}

EXTRACTION RULES:
- {{ $json.extraction_config.rules.join('\n- ') }}

ADDITIONAL RULES:
- Return VALID JSON only.
- Do not use Markdown.
- Do not wrap the JSON in ```json fences.
- Preserve every key and nesting level of the target schema.
- Do not add new keys.
- Replace null values only when the source explicitly supports a value.
- Keep null when a scalar value is unsupported.
- Keep [] when a list is unsupported.
- source_quote must contain the shortest verbatim passage that directly supports the extracted claim, preferably no more than 250 characters.
- Keep source quotes concise.
- Do not use outside knowledge.
- Do not infer therapeutic activity from chemical presence.
- Traditional use must not be presented as established clinical efficacy.
- If a pharmacopoeial monograph is mentioned anywhere in the source text, include it in pharmacopoeia_monographs, even if it is also referenced as a quality standard for a preparation.
- Every source_quote MUST be copied exactly as one contiguous substring from SOURCE TEXT.
- Never paraphrase, summarize, correct spelling, normalize punctuation, or combine separate passages inside source_quote.
- Do not use ellipses (...) inside source_quote.
- Prefer a single short sentence or sentence fragment, ideally below 200 characters.
- If no exact supporting passage exists, use null instead of inventing a quote.

TARGET JSON STRUCTURE:
{{ JSON.stringify($json.extraction_config.target_schema, null, 2) }}

SOURCE TEXT:
{{ $json.text }}

Return only the completed JSON object.

=You are repairing a previously extracted biomedical evidence JSON object.

The extraction failed validation because one or more source quotes could not be verified verbatim against the source document.

TASK:
{{ $('Define Output Schema').item.json.task_type }}

VALIDATION ERRORS:
{{ JSON.stringify($json.validation.errors, null, 2) }}

CURRENT EXTRACTED JSON:
{{ JSON.stringify($json.extracted_data, null, 2) }}

SOURCE TEXT:
{{ $('Define Output Schema').item.json.text }}

INSTRUCTIONS:

- Return the COMPLETE corrected JSON object.
- Return valid JSON only.
- Do not use Markdown or code fences.
- Preserve the existing schema exactly.
- Do not add or remove keys.
- Do not modify values that are unrelated to the validation errors.
- Repair only the fields identified by the validation errors unless another change is strictly necessary.
- Every source_quote MUST be an exact contiguous substring copied from SOURCE TEXT.
- Never paraphrase a source_quote.
- Never combine separate passages.
- Never normalize spelling or punctuation inside a quote.
- Prefer the shortest passage that directly supports the claim, ideally below 150 characters.
- If no exact passage supports the claim, set source_quote to null.
- Do not invent evidence.
- Do not use outside knowledge.

Return only the complete corrected JSON object.
